text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: We couldn't save a single one of them…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No, it's all right. I would've gotten the same result myself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And I do think a little of the passionate wind you whipped up managed to find its way past the glass.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The only other thing we can do for them is hope that someday they'll get to feel the true wind…
